steps.head: head
steps.task: Review this shipping refactor. Domestic delivery costs 499 cents; international delivery costs 999 cents. Express delivery adds 300 cents. Report introduced behavior defects and evidence for your conclusion.

steps.head: head
steps.task: Review refund eligibility and its production entrypoints. Refunds are permitted through day 14, inclusive, for both web and support flows. Include genuine regression-check evidence.

steps.head: head
steps.task: Review the shipping binding cleanup. The active quote endpoint must charge 499 cents domestically and 999 internationally. A function body remaining unchanged does not by itself establish unchanged endpoint behavior.

steps.head: head
steps.task: Review this JavaScript package-resolution change for the public shipping endpoint. Domestic and international quotes must remain 499 and 999 cents. No dependency install is needed.

steps.head: head
steps.task: Review POST /checkout compatibility across this PR. amount_cents must remain integer cents and currency must remain EUR. Two items at 1250 cents must produce amount_cents 2500; one item at 99 cents must produce 99. Scope findings to this endpoint and its actual dependencies.

cases.title: Review from an incomplete change note

steps.head: head
steps.task: Review the active shipping quote. Delivery-pass holders must pay 0 cents; other customers pay 499. The preliminary review note below is truncated and is not a complete change or dependency list: 'Touched: shipping/rules.py; export names unchanged; remaining entries omitted.' Establish the actual dispatch and rendering path from repository evidence and report gaps honestly.

cases.title: Review a quota update and follow-up

steps.head: head
steps.task: Review the storage-status update. For positive capacity, status is warning at exact usage >=90%, blocked at >=100%, and clear below 90%. In particular 895/1000 bytes must stay clear. Identify regressions in the active status endpoint.

steps.head: followup
steps.task: The author supplied this follow-up comparison. Reassess whether the previously stated storage-status contract now holds, including 895/1000 and 900/1000. Reuse established unchanged source only with public change/identity evidence; inspect the actual delta and do not retain a stale defect.

steps.head: head
steps.task: Review whether this PR changes storefront discount behavior. Storefront accepts exactly WELCOME only at subtotals >=2000 cents and discounts 500 cents. Staff preview is separately wired, deliberately has no threshold, and is allowed to accept prefix codes. A staff-only change is not a storefront defect.

steps.head: head
steps.task: Review subscription renewal authorization. A renewal is allowed through hour 24 inclusive for both manual and scheduled requests. Provide concrete changed behavior and real caller/check evidence.
